positiveControl: Each fresh original must compile completely, authenticate explicit synthetic exact dispositions, perform each original task, independently verify its own original criterion and close every node. A rejection-only engine fails.
adverseControl: The named semantic owner must report the preregistered exact issue and boundary. Syntax failures and unrelated earlier refusals do not pass.
freshness: Eight independently constructed originals per family vary actual branch width 3..10, exact rational demand denominator 1..8, task/actor identities, effort, original dates and targeted branch. No repeated original or artifact identifier.
originalFloors: No protected-family critical floor, useful-completion estimator or statistical qualification requirement is replaced or lowered by this development campaign.

families.mutation: Revoke the actual selected canonical recipient after exact acceptance.
Remove the task-specific observed skill from its actual selected producer.
An independently resolved competing commitment consumes the actual schedule capacity.
The retained disposition has a different exact terms digest.
Revoke only the current recipient capability without changing the proposed assignment.
A producer adds private task context outside the original data ceiling.
Direct exposure exceeds the exact canonical task envelope.
A canonical-shaped carve is made its own budget ancestor; operational return edges do not excuse it.
A retained delivery is purportedly verified by its own producer.
An independently verified parent attempts closure while actual children remain open.
An otherwise current third party issues the recipient's START with exact command authority bytes.
An explicit actual-shaped decline remains a decline and cannot become arrival or performance.
Original S6 identity changes from NOT_DISPATCHED to UNKNOWN or MAY_HAVE_LEFT without authoritative reconciliation.
Accepted paid human work is cancelled and labor released, but no compensation settlement is supplied.
Change one pinned producer dependency; retain a separately rooted authorized branch and its usable progress.
Change an already committed command prefix without changing the independently resolved native-style anchor.
